parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

O glorious Saint Juliana Falconieri, who from thy earliest years didst consecrate thy virginity to God, and who, inflamed with love for the suffering Christ, didst spend thy life in prayer, penance, and charitable works for the glory of God and the salvation of souls, look down with compassion upon me as I come to thee with confidence in this my need. Thou who wast so devoted to the Most Holy Eucharist that, unable to receive thy Lord sacramentally in thy last agony, thou didst have the Sacred Host placed upon thy heart — obtain for me a deep and tender love for Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament, that He may be the strength and consolation of my life as He was of thine. Intercede for me before the throne of God that I may receive the grace I now seek

if it be according to His holy will and for the good of my soul. Help me, dear saint, to imitate thy humility, thy patience in suffering, and thy burning charity, so that I may one day rejoice with thee in the eternal presence of God, whom thou didst love so perfectly on earth. Amen.
St Juliana, pray for us! Amen.
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

blocks.title: Days 1-9

fragments.text:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses,
as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
fragments.title: Our Father

fragments.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
fragments.title: Hail Mary

fragments.text:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
